findings.title: Recheck live owner before project registration after asynchronous resolution
findings.description: project/add checks requireConnection at admission, then awaits project/resolve and commits ledger.addProject without checking that the same authenticated browser owner is still live. If logout/session revocation or socket replacement occurs while resolution is pending, the resolved response can still create a new project and accepted receipt after authorization is gone.
controlFlow: GatewayServer captures the exact browser connection and supplies a callback that rechecks session/CSRF, WebSocket identity and OPEN/connecting/disconnecting state (server.ts266-271).

Dispatcher invokes that callback before the asynchronous resolver (dispatch.ts119), but its local beforeWrite only marks the receipt dispatching (132); the post-resolver addProject at144 has no callback.

Gateway revocation closes the browser socket; eventual close cleanup sends worker /disconnect. Runtime beforeWrite fences the current worker-channel/client lease, but it cannot undo or authorize a subsequent gateway-local commit after the read-only resolver result returns.

Automation commands and rotation already recheck after their await boundaries (dispatch.ts190 and64). Synchronous project/remove and operation/retire have no analogous await gap. Worktree/receipt reconciliation after a successful backend execution records existing positive evidence and should not be rolled back on disconnect.

reproduction.method: Deferred controlled project/resolve; revoke the supplied live-owner callback before resolving; then inspect the real in-memory Ledger.
reproduction.limits: In-memory Dispatcher and controlled worker only; no native worker, network, paid model, test runner, or real project filesystem.

findings.recommendation: Invoke context.requireConnection immediately before project/add beforeWrite/addProject, after resolver output validation. A failure at that point must leave no project and let the existing catch settle the reserved operation as not_sent. Add a focused regression with deferred resolution and a revoked callback/exact browser connection. Do not reject or roll back receipt persistence for backend work already executed.
findings.scopeBoundary: This finding is the demonstrated gateway-local project/add post-await mutation gap. The broader queued worker-transport revocation hypothesis is not asserted as an additional defect.
